name: 5x5 Custom Canopy Tent Package – Steel Frame with Full-Color Printing

categories.title: Custom Canopy Tents – Personalized Pop Up Tents for Events

descriptionHtml:
Specsheet Warning Label Fire Certificate

Premium 5'x 5' Custom Canopy Tent

  • Heavy-duty steel frame + wheeled carry bag
  • Dye-sublimation printed 600D Oxford fabric
  • Waterproof, Fire Resistant, UV Protection
  • Free Ground Shipping (FedEx) Nationwide

Features:

  • Canopy is constructed of durable, weather-resistant 600 denier polyester
  • Your artwork will be dye sublimated on a white canopy
  • Crank-up canopy creates a taut, clean peak
  • Frame is constructed of Steel
  • Frame features ABS glass-filled nylon joints
  • Square-shaped legs are 1.75" in diameter
  • Legs feature plastic levers for pinch-free height adjustment
  • Easily collapses to fit inside the included soft case with wheels
  • The tent can be secured to the ground with the included stake kit
  • Frame must be secured to the ground to prevent wind damage (failure to secure the tent voids the warranty)
  • Imprint Method: Full-Color Dye Sublimation

Product Dimensions

  • Product Size: 60" W x 137" H x 60" D
  • Collapsible Dimensions: 9.12" W x 62.75" H x 9.12" D
  • Case Dimensions: 12.5" W x 56.25" H x 15.5" D
  • Product Weight: Frame + Wheel Bag Weight: 30lbs

Kit Includes

  • 1: Hardware (Frame)
  • 1: Canopy
  • 1: Wheeled Carry Bag
  • 1: Ropes and Pegs Set

Optional Accessories:

  • 6' Table Cover
  • Feather Flags
  • Sandbags

Materials

  • Hardware: ABS Nylon, Steel
  • Canopy: 600 Denier Polyester

Certifications

  • Meets FR Rating Requirements
  • Primary Usage
  • Outdoor

Factory Warranty

  • We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
